name: AirTrunk SYD3 Sydney West

lat.note: Geocoded from street address via NSW Spatial Services address point for 51 HUNTINGWOOD DRIVE HUNTINGWOOD. Address point, not building centroid; campus spans a larger lot.

builder.note: project community site (fetched 2026-09-27): 'A W Edwards has been awarded the contract to deliver a new hyperscale data centre development at 51 Huntingwood Drive'

developer.note: SSD documents prepared for EMKC3 (AirTrunk-related applicant entity)

mw_it.note: AirTrunk release (fetched): '320+ MW of IT load', nine phases (Nov 2021). Community site gives 2 x 48 MW + 3 x 100 MW = 396 MW across five shells (source 3), unclear whether IT or total; consent is for 400 MW total power consumption (mw_grid)

mw_grid.note: Assessment Report: 'operational capacity of 400 Megawatts (MW)' / 'Power Consumption 400 MW'. Withdrawn Mod 1 (source 6) proposed keeping 400 MW across fewer shells

cost_aud_m.note: capital investment value $1,074,990,484 in Assessment Report (Sept 2023). EIS (Sept 2022, source 11) estimated CIV 'approximately $974 Million (excluding GST)', cold-shell only, excluding tenant fit-out. Press reports 'close to AU$1bn' (source 4); AirTrunk calls it 'multi-billion-dollar' (source 5)

authority.value: NSW Department of Planning and Environment (now DPHI)

reference.note: Modification 1 'Reduced Scale' (SSD-41589232-Mod-1, lodged Feb 2025) is shown as Withdrawn on the portal (source 6)

lodged.note: EIS dated September 2022; EIS documents uploaded to the portal 16-30 Sep 2022. SEARs issued 2 May 2022. Exact lodgement date not stated in AR. Exhibited 20 Jan - 16 Feb 2023

determined.note: portal Determination Date 15/09/2023; AR and consent dated 15 September 2023

jobs_construction.note: AR: 'expected to generate 1,333 full-time equivalent construction jobs'; EIS: 'Construction jobs ... expected to be in the order of up to 1,333 full time jobs' (from QS certificate). Basis (peak vs total) not defined

jobs_construction_other.note: community site: 'expected to create approximately 10,000 jobs during construction'; no definition

jobs_operational.note: AR: '276 operational jobs'; EIS: 'approximately 276 jobs (which includes operational and customer staff and maintenance contractors)'; community site: '276 full-time operational roles'

construction_start.note: community site: 'Construction ... commenced in 2023'; Stage 1 (2023 to 2026) site establishment and bulk earthworks

construction_end.note: expected: w.media 27 Oct 2026 (source 12, AirTrunk A$4.25bn green loan): SYD3 'is under construction and expected to be completed by mid-2028'; 'The expansion is being led by Australian construction firm A W Edwards'. expected: community site gives Stage 2 (2025 to 2028). AR: three phases of 24 months each. Baxtel (source 8, not verified) says first capacity 2027

open_questions: mw_it: operator 320+ MW IT vs community site 2x48+3x100 = 396 MW vs consented 400 MW total power; unclear which is IT

community site describes five shells in two stages after a reduction from 10 halls, but the Mod 1 reduced-scale application is shown as withdrawn on the portal; whether a replacement modification or approval exists is unconfirmed
construction jobs basis: 1,333 'full-time equivalent' jobs (AR) vs 10,000 (community site) - neither defined
